pages.title: The Forgotten Hands
pages.text: Few structures remain from the Celestine Era, when the sky itself was guided by ritual. The Mythos Celestial Pylon is one such artifact—capable of reaching beyond the world, altering weather and time by invoking immense Mythos through a Crystal catalyst.

pages.title: Shaped Recipe
pages.text: To awaken the heavens, a Mythos Storage Item—such as a Mythos Pool—must be placed upon the Pylon, containing at least 512 units of stored Mythos. When a Crystal is presented to the Pylon's altar, the ancient bond between element and sky reasserts itself:

pages.title: Thunderstorm
pages.text: Rage and static pour from the heavens. Lightning splits the sky, igniting the world with the Pylon’s fury.

pages.title: Rainfall
pages.text: A soft, endless sorrow descends. Crops thrive, rivers swell, and a strange quiet settles over the land.

pages.title: Clear Weather
pages.text: The clouds part. Birds return. The sun shines unopposed, and the world breathes anew.

pages.title: Crystal Oath
pages.text: The world is reborn in golden light. All shadows recede as the sun rises—no matter the hour.

pages.title: Crystal Grief
pages.text: Time bows to silence. The sky darkens, the moon ascends, and night claims the realm with gentle certainty.
The ritual burns the crystal, but those attuned to Mythos believe the energy lingers above, drifting among the stars.
